state.project: GTC: Banks Crossing - Pond Fork 115 kV
state.description: GTC will build a new 115kV line from McClure Industrial to structure 21N on the Ridgeway Church Road Junction or tap point (approximately 3 miles). Close normally open switch at Ridgeway Church Road to establish the Banks Crossing - Pond Fork 115kV line. All new conductors should be 100C 1351 ACSR Martin.
